entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [CI triage] Conditional-parameter template test work item reports BadExit on Azure Linux 4 x64 #57370
  • dotnetup default macOS install path (`~/Library/Application Support/dotnetup/dotnet`) contains a space and breaks Android AOT, WASM AOT, and iOS Run targets #57369
  • dotnet test cannot launch test executables from long paths on Windows #57368
  • `PublishContainer` fails for `net481`: `'4.8.1.0' is not a valid version string` in `ComputeDotnetBaseImageAndTag` #57367
  • [AI discovered CI] Microsoft.WebTools.AspireService.Tests hangs in SendLogMessageAsync_Test #57363

Closed

  • MSBuild server discards the build telemetry event; make telemetry testable #55749
  • Blazor publish tests fail when Static Web Assets copy paths exceed MAX_PATH #56500

PullRequests

Created

  • extend CA2249 to span IndexOf, IndexOfAny and IndexOfAnyExcept #57375
  • Mark remaining pure in-memory tasks as multithreadable #57374
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Mark 7 pure in-memory MSBuild tasks as multithreadable #57373
  • Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates #57366
    dependencies, github_actions
  • Prevent Aspire log notification test hangs #57364
  • Allow dotnet watch to build projects with duplicate names #57362
  • Stabilize apphost regeneration test timestamps #57361

Merged

  • Mark NETSdkError, NETSdkWarning, and NETSdkInformation as multithreadable #57371
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Mark NETSdkError, NETSdkWarning, and NETSdkInformation as multithreadable #57372
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57365
  • Fix source mapping for RID-specific tool packages #57343

Updated

  • Fix Hot Reload on static SSR pages in Blazor Web apps #56644
  • Add scheduled poll fallback to PR labeler #57350
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57352
  • Improve dotnet format whitespace performance and add persistent cache #56394
    Area-Format
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57192
